request.prompt:
日常随行航拍。设计一台便于日常携带的航拍四旋翼。
四个电机各装一副静止、完全展开的双叶螺旋桨，每个电机只装两片桨叶。
目标部位：航拍相机舱与机身，四处臂根与机身。
本次改变：沿机身纵向展开相机舱与主体的比例关系，四处臂根的轮廓顺着机臂延伸。
保持：机头朝画面上沿。机载相机朝画面上沿的地平线平视拍摄。制图者从飞机正上方看见相机外壳的顶面，前向镜面在这个视角接近一条边。机身冷灰色。
自由项：舱体安装、机身轮廓、臂根曲面和分件。
Propulsion: 5-inch 2-blade propellers; motor tilt 0°.
4 个电机，True X 布局。最大电机中心距设计值 250 mm，相邻夹角从 R1 起顺时针为 90、90、90、90°。
随附正交俯视定位图，机头朝上，红点定位电机轴心。蓝线表示机架连接。
输出正交俯视产品图，制图观察方向从无人机正上方垂直向下，机头指向画面上沿，完整显示所有电机轴心和桨叶。保持各轴心在定位图画幅内的归一化位置和留白。
浅色中性背景，照片级工业产品设计渲染，柔和棚拍侧光与接触阴影，画面无辅助线、刻度或文字。

configurator_design_fields.instruction:
探索适合日常携带的整机方案。
保留四个电机轴心、相连的机臂和前向相机。
机身外轮廓、相机安装位置与接合方式、机臂过渡、壳体曲面和分件可探索。

provider_revised_prompt: The spatial layout and normalized positioning of the four red circular motor-axis markers at the corners of an X-shaped frame in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The target image transforms the schematic diagram into a photorealistic top-down orthographic industrial product render of a portable aerial photography quadcopter aligned to <Subject 1>, replacing the black background, blue connecting lines, red dots, and white upward arrow from <Picture 1> with a physical drone on a light neutral studio surface. <Subject 1> is partially preserved; its normalized canvas placement, centered margins, nose-up orientation toward the top edge, and true-X geometry with four equally spaced 90-degree intervals remain, while the flat schematic markers are replaced by physical motors and propellers. Viewed vertically from directly above with the nose pointing to the top edge, the cool-gray quadcopter features a sleek central fuselage with longitudinal proportions extending along the body axis and four tapered arms whose root contours flow smoothly from the chassis into the arm shafts. At the four positions defined by <Subject 1>, upright zero-degree-tilt brushless motors sit atop the arm tips, each fitted with a stationary, fully unfolded 5-inch two-blade propeller consisting of exactly two symmetrical blades. Beneath the forward fuselage section, a compact gimbal camera pod extends longitudinally; seen from directly overhead, its top housing shell is visible while its forward-facing lens plane aligns nearly edge-on toward the top border, aimed horizontally toward the upper horizon. Soft studio side lighting models the matte and satin cool-gray surfaces, casting gentle contact shadows onto the clean, unannotated light neutral background with no auxiliary lines, scales, or text.
